response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM mix_shares) SELECT m.order_type_mix, m.transaction_count, m.share, m.share - b.average_share AS share_above_baseline FROM mix_shares AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE m.share > b.average_share
